question: For each course instructor in the 'keeper-zephyr' mailing list, provide the name of mailing lists they subscribe to, instructor name, earliest and latest publication years, and total number of enrolled students.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "moira_list" AS SELECT "moira_list_key" AS "moira_list_key", "moira_list_name" AS "moira_list_name", "is_moira_mailing_list" AS "is_moira_mailing_list", "is_active" AS "is_active" FROM beaver."moira_list";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "moira_list_detail" AS SELECT "moira_list_key" AS "moira_list_key", "moira_list_member" AS "moira_list_member", "moira_list_member_full_name" AS "moira_list_member_full_name", "moira_list_member_mit_id" AS "moira_list_member_mit_id" FROM beaver."moira_list_detail";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "library_reserve_catalog" AS SELECT "catalog_author_name" AS "catalog_author_name", "catalog_year" AS "catalog_year" FROM beaver."library_reserve_catalog";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "tip_material" AS SELECT "author" AS "author", "year" AS "year" FROM beaver."tip_material";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT k.mit_id,
       COALESCE(k.instructor_name, '') AS instructor_name,
       COALESCE(m.mailing_lists, '') AS mailing_lists,
       p.earliest_pub_year,
       p.latest_pub_year,
       e.total_enrolled AS total_enrolled_students
FROM tmp_keepers k
LEFT JOIN tmp_mlists m USING (mit_id)
LEFT JOIN tmp_pubs p USING (mit_id)
LEFT JOIN tmp_enroll e USING (mit_id)
ORDER BY instructor_name NULLS LAST
LIMIT 50

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT s.mit_id,
       s.instructor_name,
       COALESCE(ml.mailing_lists,'') AS mailing_lists,
       p.earliest_pub_year,
       p.latest_pub_year,
       e.total_enrolled AS total_enrolled_students
FROM tmp_seed s
LEFT JOIN tmp_ml ml USING (mit_id)
LEFT JOIN tmp_pubs p USING (mit_id)
LEFT JOIN tmp_enroll e USING (mit_id)
WHERE COALESCE(e.total_enrolled,0) > 0
ORDER BY e.total_enrolled DESC NULLS LAST, s.instructor_name
LIMIT 10
